original_title: Kratos is Out, Faye is In: God of War Laufey Creators Explain Why Kratos' Wife is the New Star

en.title: God of War's Next Star is Faye, Not Kratos: Creators Reveal Why
en.summary: PlayStation's State of Play just dropped a bombshell: the next God of War adventure shifts focus from Kratos to his wife, Faye. Developers are explaining the pivotal narrative change that brings a long-speculated character to the forefront.
en.body:
The halls of Mount Olympus and the realms of Norse mythology have long echoed with the thunderous roars and brutal axe swings of **Kratos**. However, the latest announcement out of PlayStation's State of Play reveals a seismic shift for the **God of War** franchise: **Kratos** is stepping aside, and his wife, **Faye**, is taking center stage in a new spin-off titled **God of War Laufey**. This move marks a significant departure, delving into the past and future of a character who has been a silent, yet potent, force in the recent games.

Game director **Ariel Lawrence** and Santa Monica Studio creative director **Cory Barlog** sat down with IGN to elaborate on this momentous decision. Barlog revealed that the idea of exploring **Faye**'s story has been brewing since 2018. "We'll always tell stories about Kratos, but I think for us, it was just a chance to talk about somebody who was so pivotal to the beginning and get to know them and push beyond into this new world and give us some place to be surprised and see how things connect," Lawrence explained. This isn't seen as an abandonment of **Kratos**, but rather an expansion of the established lore. **Faye**, who players learned about through flashbacks and memories in **God of War: Ragnarok**, was a constant presence, her influence woven into the fabric of **Kratos**'s journey and **Atreus**'s upbringing, even before her true role was fully unveiled.

## Faye Takes the Reins

**Faye**'s journey is deeply intertwined with the saga's origins. She is the mother of **Loki** and was **Kratos**'s second wife, whose path famously crossed his during a search for her Leviathan Axe. While she was a "phantom and a specter" in the 2018 game, her presence was undeniable, a powerful undercurrent that shaped the narrative. The developers emphasized that **Faye** is not just a narrative device but a fully realized character ready for her own spotlight. Early footage suggests that her combat style is as visceral and brutal as **Kratos**'s, albeit with a different flair. "Kratos is like a brick wall, and he's a little stoic, but it's just that his brutality is different," Lawrence hinted, suggesting **Faye** brings her own unique brand of ferocity to the battlefield.

## What This Means for the Franchise

For the passionate **God of War** community, this announcement is a thrilling prospect. The shift to **Faye** as the protagonist, coupled with rumors of incorporating East-Asian mythologies, signals a bold new direction for the franchise. This isn't just about exploring a new character; it's about expanding the universe and its narrative possibilities beyond the familiar Norse pantheon. Fans have long speculated about **Faye**'s past and her impact on the world, and **God of War Laufey** promises to finally answer those questions, offering fresh perspectives and challenging established gameplay paradigms. It's a chance to see the **God of War** universe through new eyes, exploring themes and conflicts that were previously only hinted at.

## What's Next

While specific release dates and further details for **God of War Laufey** have not yet been announced, the reveal during the PlayStation State of Play has ignited excitement. Players can anticipate a deeper dive into **Faye**'s character and her unique place within the **God of War** pantheon, promising an evolution of the series that honors its legacy while forging a new path.

tr.title: God of War'ın Yeni Yıldızı Faye, Kratos Değil: Yaratıcılar Nedenini Açıkladı
tr.summary: PlayStation'ın State of Play'i God of War serisinin yeni bir spin-off'u duyurdu: God of War Laufey. Bu yeni oyun, Kratos'un karısı Faye'nin hikayesini anlatıyor. Geliştiriciler, bu önemli narrative değişikliği ve neden Faye'nin hikayesini anlatmaya karar verdiklerini açıkladılar.
tr.body:
Mount Olympus'un salonları ve İskandinav mitolojisinin krallıkları uzun süredir **Kratos**'un gök gürültülü bağırışları ve brutål balta darbeleriyle yankılanmaktadır. Ancak, PlayStation'ın State of Play'in son açıklaması God of War serisi için bir deprem gibi oldu: **Kratos** sahneyi terk ediyor ve karısı **Faye** yeni bir spin-off olan **God of War Laufey**'de merkezde yer alıyor. Bu hareket, bir karakterin geçmişi ve geleceği hakkında uzun süredir spekülasyon yapılan bir karakteri ön plana çıkaran önemli bir ayrılmayı temsil ediyor.

 Oyun direktörü **Ariel Lawrence** ve Santa Monica Studio'nun yaratıcı direktörü **Cory Barlog**, bu önemli kararı anlatmak için IGN ile konuştu. Barlog, **Faye**'in hikayesini anlatma fikrinin 2018'den beri geliştiğini açıkladı. "Her zaman **Kratos** hakkında hikayeler anlatacağız, ama **Faye** hakkında konuşmak ve onu tanımak ve yeni bir dünya hakkında konuşmak için bir şans olarak görüyoruz" diye açıkladı Lawrence. Bu, **Kratos**'u terk etmek değil, sondern kurulu lore'u genişletmek olarak görülüyor. **Faye**, **God of War: Ragnarok**'ta flashbacks ve anılar aracılığıyla öğrenilen bir karakterdi ve **Kratos**'un yolculuğu ve **Atreus**'un yetiştirilmesinde önemli bir rol oynadı.
## Faye Sahneyi Ele Geçiriyor
 **Faye**'in hikayesi, serinin kökenleriyle derinlemesine bağlantılıdır. O, **Loki**'nin annesi ve **Kratos**'un ikinci karısıdır ve Leviathan Axe'i ararken yolunun **Kratos**'la kesiştiği famous bir karakterdir. Geliştiriciler, **Faye**'in yalnızca bir narrative aracı değil, kendi ışığındaFully realized bir karakter olduğunu vurguladılar. Erken görüntüler, onun savaş stilinin **Kratos**'unki kadar vahşi ve brutål olduğunu, ancak farklı bir tarzda olduğunu gösteriyor. "**Kratos** bir tuğla duvar gibi ve biraz stoik, ama sadece brutality'si farklı" diye ima etti Lawrence, **Faye**'in savaş alanında kendi benzersiz brutality'sini getireceğini öne sürdü.
## Bu, Seri için Ne Anlama Geliyor
 **God of War** topluluğu için bu açıklama heyecan verici bir perspektiftir. **Faye**'in protagonist olarak alınması ve Doğu Asya mitolojilerinin dahil edilmesiyle, seri için cesur bir yeni yön ortaya çıkıyor. Bu, yalnızca bir karakteri keşfetmek değil, evreni ve narrative olasılıklarını İskandinav panteonunun ötesine genişletmek hakkında. Hayranlar, **Faye**'in geçmişi ve dünyadaki etkileri hakkında uzun süredir spekülasyon yapıyorlar ve **God of War Laufey**, sonunda bu soruları cevaplayacağına ve taze perspektifler sunacağına söz veriyor.
## Sonraki Adımlar
 **God of War Laufey** için specific çıkış tarihleri ve daha fazla ayrıntı henüz açıklanmadı, ancak PlayStation State of Play'deki açıklama heyecanı ateşledi. Oyuncular, **Faye**'in karakteri ve **God of War** panteonundaki benzersiz yerine daha derin bir bakış bekleyebilirler ve serinin mirasını onurlandırırken yeni bir yol açacağına söz veriyorlar.

es.title: La próxima estrella de God of War es Faye, no Kratos: Los creadores revelan por qué
es.summary: El State of Play de PlayStation acaba de anunciar un cambio significativo en la franquicia God of War: Kratos deja paso a su esposa, Faye, en un nuevo spin-off titulado God of War Laufey. Los desarrolladores explican el cambio narrativo que lleva a un personaje largamente especulado al centro del escenario.
es.body:
El salón de Mount Olympus y los reinos de la mitología nórdica han resonado durante mucho tiempo con los rugidos y golpes brutales de **Kratos**. Sin embargo, el último anuncio de PlayStation's State of Play revela un cambio sísmico para la franquicia **God of War**: **Kratos** se hace a un lado y su esposa, **Faye**, toma el centro del escenario en un nuevo spin-off titulado **God of War Laufey**. Este movimiento marca una desviación significativa, explorando el pasado y el futuro de un personaje que ha sido una fuerza silenciosa pero potente en los juegos recientes.

El director de juego **Ariel Lawrence** y el director creativo de Santa Monica Studio **Cory Barlog** se sentaron con IGN para elaborar sobre esta decisión importante. Barlog reveló que la idea de explorar la historia de **Faye** ha estado germinando desde 2018. "Siempre contaremos historias sobre Kratos, pero creo que para nosotros, fue solo una oportunidad de hablar sobre alguien que fue tan fundamental para el comienzo y conocerla y empujar más allá en este nuevo mundo y darnos un lugar para sorprender y ver cómo se conectan las cosas", explicó Lawrence. Esto no se ve como un abandono de **Kratos**, sino más bien como una expansión de la lore establecida. **Faye**, a quien los jugadores conocieron a través de flashbacks y recuerdos en **God of War: Ragnarok**, fue una presencia constante, su influencia tejida en la trama de **Kratos** y la educación de **Atreus**, incluso antes de que su papel fuera completamente revelado.

## Faye Toma el Control

El viaje de **Faye** está profundamente entrelazado con los orígenes de la saga. Ella es la madre de **Loki** y la segunda esposa de **Kratos**, cuyo camino famosamente se cruzó con el suyo durante una búsqueda de su Hacha Leviatán. Aunque fue un "fantasma y un espectro" en el juego de 2018, su presencia fue innegable, una poderosa corriente subterránea que dio forma a la narrativa. Los desarrolladores enfatizaron que **Faye** no es solo un dispositivo narrativo, sino un personaje completamente realizado listo para su propio protagonismo. Las primeras imágenes sugieren que su estilo de combate es tan visceral y brutal como el de **Kratos**, aunque con un toque diferente. "Kratos es como un muro de ladrillos, y es un poco estoico, pero es solo que su brutalidad es diferente", insinuó Lawrence, sugiriendo que **Faye** aporta su propia marca única de ferocidad al campo de batalla.

## Qué Significa Esto para la Franquicia

Para la apasionada comunidad de **God of War**, este anuncio es una perspectiva emocionante. El cambio a **Faye** como protagonista, junto con rumores de incorporar mitologías de Asia Oriental, señala una dirección audaz y nueva para la franquicia. Esto no se trata solo de explorar a un nuevo personaje; se trata de expandir el universo y sus posibilidades narrativas más allá del familiar panteón nórdico. Los fanáticos han especulado durante mucho tiempo sobre el pasado de **Faye** y su impacto en el mundo, y **God of War Laufey** promete finalmente responder a esas preguntas, ofreciendo perspectivas frescas y desafiando paradigmas de juego establecidos. Es una oportunidad de ver el universo de **God of War** a través de nuevos ojos, explorando temas y conflictos que anteriormente solo se insinuaban.

## Próximos Pasos

Aunque las fechas de lanzamiento específicas y más detalles para **God of War Laufey** aún no han sido anunciados, el anuncio durante el State of Play de PlayStation ha encendido la emoción. Los jugadores pueden anticipar una inmersión más profunda en el personaje de **Faye** y su lugar único dentro del panteón de **God of War**, prometiendo una evolución de la serie que honra su legado mientras forja un nuevo camino.

content_raw: The biggest news to come out of PlayStation's State of Play wasn't just that there was a new God of War game, but that Kratos was sitting this one out and his wife, Faye, was taking the starring role. God of War Laufey's game director Ariel Lawrence and Santa Monica Studio creative director Cory Barlog spoke exclusively to IGN ahead of the showcase to explain why. "We'll always tell stories about Kratos, but I think for us, it was just a chance to talk about somebody who was so pivotal to the beginning and get to know them and push beyond into this new world and give us some place to be surprised and see how things connect. So for us, it's not a departure; it's more of an expansion." Barlog explained that he knew way back in 2018 that Faye was a character that he knew he wanted to explore, and God of War Laufey is the way to do it. "The character to usher us into this sort of new world is this character, who is such an anchor to the rebirth of where we were going with the franchise." He points out that Faye has been key to the recent games, even if she wasn't always front and center. "She was omnipresent but visually not represented. In 2018 she was a feeling; she was a phantom and a specter but one whose tendrils stretched out through the entirety of the narrative, and it gave her this interesting sense of power inside of it. It was like, man, it would be so interesting to see who she was before, but it also would be interesting to see how things continue forward." It's clear too in the footage shown, which represents the first 20 minutes of the game, and in the discussions with Lawrence and Barlog, that Faye is just as brutal as her hubby when it comes to combat. "Kratos is like a brick wall, and he's a little stoic, but it's just that his brutality is different," said Lawrence. "How do we show somebody who's his equal as she is? So when we looked, we got to think about all the [Santa Monica] games. The Greek era had an influence on Faye. The Norse era has an influence on Faye. So going to our more agile combat roots but also retaining our companions, our gritty closer combat. How do those marry together and then make something that's uniquely Faye-feeling while still being a Santa Monica game?" There's no release date for the game just yet, but you can find out more in the full interview with Lawrence and Barlog on IGN. Rachel Weber is the Head of Editorial Development at IGN and an elder millennial. She's been a professional nerd since 2006 when she got her start on Official PlayStation Magazine in the UK, and has since worked for GamesIndustry.Biz, Rolling Stone and GamesRadar. She loves horror, horror movies, horror games, Red Dead Redemption 2, and her Love and Deepspace boyfriends.
